title: Paired development test of integrated PLM capacity expansion
purpose: Select a working-capacity configuration using only a held-in development split. The sealed E2E-005 held-out compositions remain permanently excluded from training and development evaluation.
selection_rule: Candidate capacity may be selected using mean held-in development q2 accuracy; no E2E-005 result, held-out episode, or future confirmatory result may be used.
integrity: All development evaluation episodes are generated after training from a separate RNG namespace; exact episode keys must have zero overlap with training; action labels are outside model.query; no auxiliary payload-bit labels are supplied.
question: Does hidden_dim=64 improve the selected integrated PLM configuration on a fixed development split relative to hidden_dim=40 under the same training episodes, optimizer and evaluation episodes?
hypothesis: A capacity-increased hidden_dim=64 model will improve development q2 accuracy relative to hidden_dim=40 without using the sealed E2E-005 held-out compositions.

endpoints.name: development_q2_accuracy
endpoints.description: Mean q2 accuracy on the registered development composition set.

decision_rule.condition: hidden64 mean development q2 accuracy >= 0.80 and hidden64 mean exceeds hidden40 mean
decision_rule.licenses: hidden_dim=64 is the selected capacity for a subsequent confirmatory experiment
decision_rule.does_not_license: any claim on the sealed E2E-005 test set, real-world multimodal competence, or architecture superiority in general

decision_rule.condition: hidden64 does not improve the primary endpoint
decision_rule.licenses: do not select hidden_dim=64 on this development criterion

held_constant: same learning rate and weight decay
same evaluation episodes within each seed for both capacity arms
sealed E2E-005 held-out compositions never used for training or selection
no E2E-005 measured outcome used for selection
